prompt: Make a welcome series for https://example-brand.test, photos in ./assets, colors #1F1B16 #F5F1EA #A34A28
expected: Prints MARGARITA_PREFLIGHT; picks the welcome flow from data/occasions.json (4 emails with delays); one primary CTA per email; every fact sourced or the block dropped; build, preflight and render all PASS; notes.md lists inferred elements
tests: flow skeleton + fact law + one CTA + checks run

prompt: Show me email styles for my candle shop
expected: Shows previews from library/INDEX.md first (style tour and the candles entry) without building; then builds the first real email in the 2 or 3 styles picked and runs gallery.py
tests: library consulted before building + style choice loop

prompt: Black Friday email for this store, 20% off with code FRIDAY20, ends Sunday at midnight
expected: Uses the real code and deadline verbatim in an offer_code block; no invented urgency or stock claims; subject under 50 characters; no em dashes
tests: offer facts verbatim + house style + subject length

prompt: Launch email for our new supplement, link only, no photos
expected: Text-led layout; supplements compliance from data/niches.csv (FDA disclaimer, no disease claims); logs every voice and product cue as inferred when the page does not state it
tests: niche compliance + no-asset fallback + inferred log

prompt: Use the Hearth Field candles example for my brand
expected: Borrows block order and style from library/specs/candles.json but replaces every product, price, review and photo with the real brand's; never ships demo copy or .test links
tests: library is structure only, never facts

prompt: Design a welcome popup for my coffee brand with 10% off
expected: Adds a popups entry (welcome-offer preset) to the spec, runs popup.py, delivers mockup.html and a Klaviyo build sheet; side image desktop only; success step shows the code
